title: Same Job in Spark SQL
description: Re-implement Aggregate Product Totals using Spark SQL only (temp view + spark.sql), not DataFrame groupBy/agg. Line revenue = quantity * unit_price * (1 - discount_pct), round half-up to 2 decimals per line, then sum. Output: product_id, total_units, total_revenue, txn_count, store_count. Write Parquet with overwrite.

problemStatement.overview: SQL aggregate of discounted product totals; write Parquet to OUTPUT_PATH.

yourTaskSteps: Read INPUT_PATH and register a temp view.
spark.sql aggregate with per-line discounted revenue.
Write product_id, total_units, total_revenue, txn_count, store_count.
